_comment: GoClaw model_fallback fleet policy — single source of truth. Apply: scripts/apply-tier-policy.ps1. Verify: same script with -Verify.
_quota_note: Codex = quota TUAN cua ChatGPT Team. Tu v5 (2026-09-23) quota Codex DANH RIENG cho agent `codex` (Discord bot rieng). Moi agent/cron khac chay Gemini qua antigravity: ag-pro -> ag-flash-38. Cron KHONG co model override (CronPayload chi co kind/message/command), nen doi agent la doi luon cron. Do lai bang _measure_query: sau migrate chi con agent_key=codex.
_measure_query: SELECT a.agent_key, count(*) calls, sum(s.input_tokens) in_tok FROM spans s JOIN agents a ON a.id=s.agent_id WHERE s.metadata->'model_fallback'->>'selected_provider_name'='openai-codex' AND s.created_at > now() - interval '3 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY in_tok DESC;

_groups.X: agent `codex` — tier1 Codex gpt-6-sol (tu 2026-09-23; gpt-6-astra/gpt-6-luna cung da probe song tren account Team), het quota thi roi xuong Gemini. Mot nac GPT duy nhat: 429 usage_limit_reached la cap account, them model gpt thu 2 chi ton them 1 call fail.
_groups.B: output cho NGUOI doc (Discord/chat) — Gemini thuan ag-pro -> ag-flash-38 (truoc v5 la Codex tier1).
_groups.M: output cho MAY tieu thu (Sheet/webhook/format cung) — ag-opus tier1, chuoi NGAN + canh bao Discord khi rot tier (deadman Check C).
_groups.C: bulk/re — primary ag-flash-38. Nac 3 = agy-claude/ag-opus de thoat khoi MOT mien quota antigravity.

_alias_note: Chi dung alias co trong live /v1/models cua cliproxy: ag-pro, ag-pro-low, ag-opus, ag-flash-38, ag-image. ag-flash va ag-flash-37 DA CHET (bi exclude 2026-09-03) — slot tro vao chung rot tier moi luot.
_codex_note: openai-codex dung CHUNG OAuth identity voi Codex CLI tren host (codex login, /worker, /delegate codex, plan-review bus). CLI refresh -> OpenAI xoay refresh token -> GoClaw chet 401 refresh_token_reused -> agent codex am tham chay Gemini. Dung CLI xong PHAI tra token: bash skills/daily-report/sync_codex_token.sh. Fix tan goc: identity OAuth rieng cho GoClaw.
